Re-pinned the dogfood binary to lambo-e11fb06 (lambo-for-mooshik @ e11fb06, clean tree, LAMBO_GIT_SHA set, features store-sqlite,embed-candle-metal,embed-bge). This pin carries the record_action embedder-hop fix (record_action concepts previously stored embedding NULL — everything an agent DID was invisible to semantic recall) and the new re-embed --missing-only repair verb. Ran the repair with serve stopped: backfilled 42 NULL-vector concepts, coverage 534/576 -> 576/576, contract untouched (candle BAAI/bge-m3, dim 1024). Repointed launchd from lambo-4c6fc93, restarted, verified: lease http-shared-writer pid 35655, MCP stats embedded=576/576, ledger heartbeat git_sha=e11fb06. [Resource] (score 7.77)

Dogfood finding (2026-08-20, DOGFOOD-FINDINGS.md): 92 of 100 concepts in the lambo-dev store carry no durable embedding — interleaved in time, not one outage window; all 44 record_action Resources plus most Constraints/Logics/Entities. Semantic recall and dedup are blind to them and the damage is cumulative with no backfill path. Candidate product work: embedding-coverage counter in lambo_stats, and a re-embed backfill verb. Cause unsettled: record_action-never-embeds by design, intermittent embedder unavailability degrading hybrid to keyword, or a flush gap. [Entity] (score 6.90)

G3's most valuable side-finding (2026-08-21): lambo's dogfood graph connects ARTIFACTS, not REASONING, and the Derives/Temporal provenance spine does not fix it. Adding the Derives co-parent projection collapses 41 islands to only 40 (giant component 266 -> 271), so record_action provenance is NOT what joins the islands -- Causal edges are (207 edges, 170 concepts, largest single-type component 135). The giant component holds 92% of Resource and 85% of Entity concepts but only 49% of Constraint, 37% of Logic and 30% of Observation. Mechanism: record_action writes Causal/Dependency edges to shared file and commit resources, which become hubs; lambo_derive writes only intra-call CoOccurrence cliques (capped by max_cooccurrence_per_derive, largest CoOccurrence component 11) plus Hierarchical edges from the rarely-used parent_of (25 edges total). So the decisions, lessons and constraints agents derive arrive edge-less and strand on islands, and NO phase-2 expansion algorithm can reach them from an artifact hit. Fix connectivity before fixing the traversal.

Solo policy simulation on the Mac store (2026-09-04, action term only, recurrence ignored): 12 concepts would be Canonical, 20 Venerable, 58 Candidate, 781 None. Solo's score is recurrence_sessions*1 + human_confirmed*4 + valid_action_count*2 - reverts*3, times type resistance, with bars 3/6/10; valid_action_count is distinct action concepts with Causal or Dependency edges INTO the concept. So under Solo the things that promote are record_action resource strings (files, commits, PRs) that many actions touched, not decisions or constraints. Switching the dogfood rig to Solo would end the zero-promotion state but would canonize artifacts. access_count and last_accessed are never written by any code path (documented as dead in PHASE-4-daemon.md), so recall frequency cannot feed either policy.
